exclude-git-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-git-commit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-git-commit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-git-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-export-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-push.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-sync.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

exclude-stack-submit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

skip-stack-submit.note: Leaves a pre-push or pre-commit step out, which turns off a check the repository runs on the agent.

local-config-write-skip.note: Writes a skip into lefthook's local config, which leaves the step out of every later push.

local-config-edit-exclude.note: Adds an exclude_tags entry to lefthook's local config, which leaves the lint steps out of every later commit.

local-config-shell-skip.note: Writes a skip into lefthook's local config, which leaves the step out of every later push.

config-git-commit.note: Runs the pre-commit hook from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

config-git-push.note: Runs the pre-push hook from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

config-stack-submit.note: Runs the hooks of every push in the stack from a config the agent chose, in place of the repository's own lefthook config.

hooks-path-git-commit.note: Points git at a hooks folder with no hooks, so the commit runs none of the repository's checks.

hooks-path-git-push.note: In a linked worktree .git is a file, so .git/hooks names no folder and the push runs no hooks.

hooks-path-stack-push.note: Sets git's hooks folder through the environment gh stack passes to git, so the stack pushes run no hooks.

plain-git-push.note: Pushes the task branch with every hook step on.

plain-stack-submit.note: Submits the stack with every hook step on.

empty-exclude-push.note: An empty LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE leaves no step out.

local-config-write-output.note: Changes only what lefthook prints; every step still runs.

config-kept-push.note: Names the lefthook config the worktree already loads, so every step runs.

hooks-path-kept-commit.note: Names the repository's own hooks folder, so the commit runs every hook.

hooks-path-kept-stack-submit.note: Names the repository's own hooks folder, so every push in the stack runs every hook.
